activity_records_daily_only_check.name: activity_records_daily_only_check
activity_records_daily_only_check.value: "activity_records"."kind" = 'daily_work' or ("activity_records"."work_type" is null and "activity_records"."work_type_other" is null and "activity_records"."action_taken" is null and "activity_records"."result" is null and "activity_records"."pending" is null and "activity_records"."next_action" is null and "activity_records"."report_to_text" is null and "activity_records"."note" is null)

activity_records_meeting_only_check.name: activity_records_meeting_only_check
activity_records_meeting_only_check.value: "activity_records"."kind" = 'meeting' or ("activity_records"."subject" is null and "activity_records"."started_at" is null and "activity_records"."ended_at" is null and "activity_records"."method" is null and "activity_records"."counterparty" is null and "activity_records"."client_company_id" is null and "activity_records"."sections" is null)

activity_records_meeting_required_check.name: activity_records_meeting_required_check
activity_records_meeting_required_check.value: "activity_records"."kind" <> 'meeting' or ("activity_records"."subject" is not null and "activity_records"."started_at" is not null)

activity_records_times_check.name: activity_records_times_check
activity_records_times_check.value: "activity_records"."ended_at" is null or "activity_records"."started_at" is null or "activity_records"."ended_at" >= "activity_records"."started_at"

candidate_assessments_scores_check.name: candidate_assessments_scores_check
candidate_assessments_scores_check.value: ("candidate_assessments"."score_japanese" is null or "candidate_assessments"."score_japanese" between 1 and 5) and ("candidate_assessments"."score_attitude" is null or "candidate_assessments"."score_attitude" between 1 and 5) and ("candidate_assessments"."score_fitness" is null or "candidate_assessments"."score_fitness" between 1 and 5) and ("candidate_assessments"."score_motivation" is null or "candidate_assessments"."score_motivation" between 1 and 5)

residence_cards_received_by_check.name: residence_cards_received_by_check
residence_cards_received_by_check.value: ("residence_cards"."renewal_status" = 'received') = ("residence_cards"."received_by" is not null) and ("residence_cards"."received_by" is null or "residence_cards"."received_by" in ('staff','worker'))

residence_cards_status_dates_check.name: residence_cards_status_dates_check
residence_cards_status_dates_check.value: ("residence_cards"."additional_docs_on" is null or "residence_cards"."applied_on" is null or "residence_cards"."additional_docs_on" >= "residence_cards"."applied_on") and ("residence_cards"."rejected_on" is null or "residence_cards"."applied_on" is null or "residence_cards"."rejected_on" >= "residence_cards"."applied_on")

residence_cards_dates_check.name: residence_cards_dates_check
residence_cards_dates_check.value: "residence_cards"."applied_on" is null or "residence_cards"."received_on" is null or "residence_cards"."applied_on" <= "residence_cards"."received_on"

residence_cards_handover_check.name: residence_cards_handover_check
residence_cards_handover_check.value: "residence_cards"."handed_over_on" is null or ("residence_cards"."received_by" = 'staff' and "residence_cards"."received_on" is not null and "residence_cards"."handed_over_on" >= "residence_cards"."received_on")
